title: Juice: Shishkin and Cather
content: This is the first of a little feature called “Juice,” where I pair up an artist with a quote. Each has inspired me in some way or stimulated a new pathway of thinking. Please post a comment and share your thoughts.“Artistic growth is, more than anything else, a refining of the sense of truthfulness.”Quote by WillaCatherArt by IvanShishkin
